json.title: Sr. Manager, SEO and AEO
json.descriptionHtml:
The pay range for this role is $130,000 - $160,000/yr USD.

WHO WE ARE:

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Skechers Digital Ecommerce Group is seeking a talented Senior Manager of SEO and AEO to own and lead the organic search program as we continue to evolve our direct-to-consumer (DTC) business. This role owns the end-to-end organic roadmap - including technical SEO, content strategy, GEO/AEO innovation, and local store visibility – with direct impact on scalable customer acquisition and revenue growth.

This leader will set the strategic vision for how Skechers shows up across traditional and AI-driven search surfaces, build and develop a high-performing SEO team, and serve as the internal authority on organic search across the organization. Partnering closely with Digital Ecommerce, Promotions, IT, Retail Merchandising, Creative/Brand, and Customer Care, this role embeds search-first thinking at every level of the digital roadmap while driving measurable business outcomes.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own and drive the holistic global SEO + GEO/AEO strategy, setting the multi-year organic roadmap, allocating resources, and making prioritization decisions in partnership with Digital leadership.

  • Lead, develop, and grow a team of SEO professionals — setting clear goals, providing regular coaching, and building team capability across technical SEO and emerging AEO/GEO disciplines.

  • Partner closely with Digital Ecommerce, IT, Promotions, Retail Merchandising, and Creative/Brand to embed SEO and AEO requirements early into product, site, and campaign planning.

  • Own organic performance reporting to senior leadership — defining KPIs, building measurement frameworks, and connecting organic performance to revenue, customer acquisition, and LTV outcomes.

  • Serve as the internal authority on organic and AI-driven search, educating stakeholders, managing agencies and contractors, and translating industry shifts into clear roadmap recommendations

  • Own local listings strategy and lead Skechers' approach to AI-driven search surfaces including LLMs, AI Overviews, and answer engines

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • 8+ years of SEO experience with a proven track record of driving significant attributable organic growth through deep expertise in both technical and content strategies.

  • People leadership experience — demonstrated ability to build, manage, and develop an SEO team in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment.

  • AEO/GEO ownership — specific examples of building and executing AI search strategies, not just awareness of the landscape.

  • Strong platform proficiency — Google Search Console, Merchant Center, SEMrush, Botify (or equivalent enterprise crawling tools), and emerging AI search measurement platforms

  • AI proficiency — advanced prompt engineering, data handling, and the ability to select and deploy the right AI tools to drive team productivity and execution quality.

  • Operational excellence — proven ability to build scalable processes, workflows, and reporting systems across internal teams and agency partners.

  • Stakeholder influence — track record of driving cross-functional alignment and roadmap prioritization without direct authority.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 8+ years of continuous SEO experience, with at least 4 years in a team management role.

  • Demonstrated experience owning an SEO program end-to-end at a DTC or e-commerce brand.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • Must be able to work a hybrid schedule from our Manhattan Beach, CA headquarters.

#LI-LA1

About Skechers

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.


Equal Employment Opportunity
Skechers is committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and respectful work environment. Skechers provides equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment without regard race, color, religion, gender, gender identification and expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic established by local, state or federal law.


Reasonable Accommodation

The skills, abilities and physical demands described are representative of those duties that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. json.title: Content Manager, Digital Experience
json.descriptionHtml:
What to Expect

We are looking for a talented, passionate Content Manager to join our growing Digital Content team based in Fremont. The successful candidate will be responsible for collaborating with multiple stakeholders to write, optimize, publish and manage high-quality content across our global website, ensuring that visitors to our site have a seamless and positive user experience.


What You'll Do
  • Proactively collaborate with multiple stakeholders to produce content and take ownership for quality and accuracy on tesla.com
  • Write and edit content to ensure online content supports search engine optimization (SEO) goals, our brand standards, web style guidelines and legal and compliance requirements
  • Conduct simple keyword research and use SEO guidelines in writing
  • Track and manage multiple projects while meeting tight deadlines
  • Participate in the full web production lifecycle, including scoping out content requirements, production, testing and ongoing management
  • Support localization of global web content
  • Incorporate learnings from analytics data into the development of content
  • Optimize metadata and on-page content based on priority
  • Manage content daily in the content management system (CMS)

What You'll Bring
  • 1-3 years experience in copywriting for user-facing content and search engine optimization (SEO)
  • Understanding of content optimization and keyword research
  • Experience in writing for a global audience
  • Superior proofreading and copywriting skills
  • Eye for detail, even under pressure
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and go above and beyond to meet deadlines
  • Experience in using a content management system (CMS)

Compensation and Benefits
Benefits

  • Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
  • Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
  • Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
  • Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
  • Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
  • Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
  • Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
  • Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
  • Tesla Babies program
  • Commuter benefits
  • Employee discounts and perks program
Expected Compensation
$64,000 - $156,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.


Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

json.descriptionHtml:
Product manager

Senior Product Manager (SEO/Web) - User Growth (San Jose)

Location
:

San Jose

Employment Type
:

Regular

Job Code
:

A14329A

Responsibilities

Team Introduction:
The User Growth (UG) team is responsible for the growth of ByteDance's international products, including TikTok. We help develop customized growth strategies for the products and utilize various marketing, product, and data analysis techniques to achieve business growth goals. The UG team maintains and optimizes a range of mature product growth strategies, such as paid advertising and organic user acquisition, and skillfully applies them to various businesses to drive growth. Additionally, when new growth opportunities are identified, we create new solutions to help businesses achieve breakthroughs. By joining the UG team, you will be responsible for the growth of products with billions of users and gain hands-on experience in cutting-edge growth practices.

Responsibilities:
  • Own iteration and international growth strategy for the TikTok Web product, using organic search (SEO) as a primary growth channel. Scope includes page experience and design, information architecture, content distribution, KPI frameworks, and experimentation platforms for the full Web product lifecycle.
  • Partner directly with external search engine companies and other search-engine teams to validate advanced search strategies and technical guidance, and rapidly translate those findings into actionable product and engineering plans.
  • Design and implement end-to-end SEO programs — including standardized information architecture, structured data, traffic acquisition tactics, and client-side conversion funnels — and coordinate with Web and App product and engineering teams to operationalize them.
  • Lead full lifecycle product delivery from business analysis and roadmapping through solution design, requirement decomposition, development coordination, launch validation and continuous iteration. Mobilize cross-functional stakeholders (product, engineering, data, content and operations) to ensure timely, high-quality execution.
  • Localize and scale growth strategies for global markets: adapt information architecture, metadata, and distribution pathways to regional, linguistic and cultural differences while ensuring scalability, sustainability and regulatory compliance across multiple countries and languages.
Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
  • 3+ years of product experience in internet or digital businesses (or equivalent career progression), with hands-on exposure to Web products, content distribution or user-growth initiatives.
  • End-to-end product mindset that connects business objectives to technical implementation. Able to deliver tightly-coupled solutions across page design, information architecture and engineering; treats SEO as a product lever within a broader product ecosystem.
  • Proven experience working directly with large third-party platforms or technical teams to align on requirements and integrate external rules or new technologies into product roadmaps.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Demonstrated ability to craft deep, multi-dimensional strategies in complex business contexts with a focus on long-term value and systematic growth; experience or strong motivation for cross-border and cross-cultural product rollout.
  • Excellent cross-team collaboration and project management skills, strong logical thinking and communication skills will be preferred.
  • Prior involvement in SEO/search/recommendation projects is a strong plus.
Job Information

【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually)

The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $151200 - $311600 annually.

​

Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

​

Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).

​

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.

​

For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:
​

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:

​

1. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;

​

2. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and

​

3. Exercising sound judgment.

​

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

​

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

​

​

Diversity & Inclusion

​

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

​

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at

Take charge of and develop the SEO approach and plan for Adobe Firefly, including prioritization across feature pages, workflows, and evergreen growth initiatives.
Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Design to integrate SEO requirements into page templates, feature launches, and platform decisions.
Drive the strategy and optimization of Firefly’s feature page ecosystem, including internal linking frameworks and scalable content systems.
Own SEO mentorship for product and feature launches, ensuring discoverability is built in from the beginning.
Define and maintain Firefly’s keyword universe, topic taxonomy, and demand mapping, aligned to customer intent and product priorities.
Collaborate with analytics teams to assess SEO and GEO performance, interpret insights into clear recommendations, and share progress and tradeoffs with senior partners.
Function as the final SEO decision-maker for Firefly initiatives, balancing impact, resourcing, and long-term scalability.

What you need to succeed
4+ years of SEO experience, with ownership of strategy for large-scale, high-visibility products or platforms.
Strong foundation in content systems and workflows.
Proven experience collaborating across Product, Engineering, Development, and Marketing teams.
Experience defining and accomplishing SEO strategies in fast paced, ambiguous environments.
Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to translate data into clear priorities and decisions.
Technical SEO expertise.
Preferred qualifications
Experience working on SEO for AI-powered products and adapting strategies for discovery driven by large language models.
Experience scaling feature-led or product-led SEO programs.
Familiarity with international SEO considerations and multi-market performance analysis.

json.descriptionHtml:
Marketing Manager

EntryPoint is a digital marketing company that drives brand sales at the store level. Our AI-powered “check in” kiosks network, installed in nearly 2,000 grocery stores across the East Coast, including Food Lion, Winn-Dixie, Stop & Shop, and Price Chopper/Market 32, connects CPG brands with shoppers at the moment of purchase through digital advertised coupons, in-store media, brand messaging and personalized offers. We're growing fast, and our store network will continue to expand over the next 12–18 months.

We're looking for a Marketing Manager who is equal parts analyst and storyteller — someone who can dig into grocery transaction data, find the insight that matters, and walk a CPG client through it with confidence. You'll work alongside our Sales team as a strategic partner, owning the analytical and presentation work that wins new business and deepens existing client relationships.

What You'll Do

Client & Sales Partnership

  • Function as the day-to-day marketing partner to assigned Sales VP, supporting account strategy, client prep, and in-meeting execution
  • Participate and/or lead client conversations across the full program lifecycle — from initial pitch through interim results, final performance, and renewal
  • Build and deliver compelling presentations to CPG brand teams that clearly communicate category dynamics, promotion strategy, and ROI

Analytics & Campaign Performance

  • Analyze brand and category sales data using proprietary data profiling tools to identify promotion opportunities and competitive threats
  • Translate campaign performance data into clear, actionable narratives — not just reporting, but recommending what to do next
  • Monitor in-flight campaigns and flag adjustments needed to hit client objectives
  • Develop post-program analyses that connect program activity to measurable sales outcomes and drive future planning
  • Extract best practice learnings across campaigns to build repeatable stories on the value of data-driven promotion

Program & Content Development

  • Design marketing campaigns grounded in market trends, consumer insights, and competitive landscape analysis — built to address CPG brand challenges and drive measurable growth
  • Own the development of client materials and presentations used for customer meetings and program sell-in
  • Maintain knowledge of the grocery retail environment through regular in-store and online visits
  • Stay ahead of industry trends in shopper marketing, retail media, and CPG promotions — bring new ideas to the team proactively

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Market Research, Business Administration, or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in CPG, retail/trade/shopper marketing, or a promotion or couponing agency
  • High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Hands-on experience with syndicated data tools (e.g. Circana/IRI, Nielsen, or SPINS)
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to build a clear narrative from complex data
  • Proven ability to build and deliver polished, persuasive presentations to external clients
  • Experience supporting or partnering directly with a sales team in a client-facing capacity

Skills That Set You Apart

  • Curious by nature — you keep asking "why" until you find something actionable
  • As comfortable in a client meeting as you are in a spreadsheet
  • Able to take a complex data story and make it land in a 30-minute presentation
  • You understand what drives CPG brand decision-making and can speak their language
  • Organized, self-directed, and able to manage multiple client priorities simultaneously

Growth Path

This role has a development track into direct Sales or into Market Research / Category specialization, depending on where your strengths and interests take you.

*The above is not an all-inclusive list of your responsibilities and skills, which may include suitable areas not specifically mentioned above.

The annual salary range for this position is $55,000–$80,000, based on experience. We offer an excellent suite of employee benefits, including health insurance (including vision), disability, flexible spending, and 401k with Company match.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $55,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Education:

  • Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

  • Retail Grocery: 2 years (Required)
  • Marketing: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

AI Visibility & Search Strategy Specialist | GEO/SEO

Dallas, TX, United States

Apply Now

Job Description

Change the world. Love your job.

Texas Instruments is seeking a AI Visibility & Search Strategy Specialist. In this role, you will contribute to the strategy for how our technology is perceived by LLMs and Search Engines. This isn't just about keywords; it’s about Generative Experience Optimization (GEO) and high-level content strategy. You will use advanced visibility tools to track scores and insights across a strategic list of prompts, translating those scores into actionable recommendations for the business. On the day to day you will monitor and analyze our Web and AI visibility performance, own specific projects that will improve this visibility and interact with various stakeholders (internal and external) to drive execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Execution: Develop and refine SEO, GEO, and LLM visibility strategies to improve our share in LLM response for our semiconductor portfolio.
  • Defining the Unknown: Help us define new KPIs. Since traditional metrics (like immediate revenue) don't always capture the impact of AI visibility, you will help create the metrics that prove our success.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: We depend on many teams for execution. You will act as the "bridge," communicating priorities and creating collaborative touchpoints with content, web, and engineering teams.
  • Fail Fast & Learn: Propose bold, new ideas and testing protocols. We value the "positive failure", learning quickly from what doesn’t work to double down on what does.
  • Data Storytelling: Analyze visibility scores and insights, making the data "speak" to stakeholders through clear, high-impact presentations and recommendations.

Texas Instruments will not sponsor job applicants for visas or work authorization for this position.

Qualifications

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, Data Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 3 years of experience in SEO, GEO, LLM, Digital Strategy, or Data Analytics and Visualization with a proven track record of solving "unstructured" problems.
  • Technical Savvy: Familiarity with LLM architectures, Search Engine algorithms, and web optimization strategies. Since LLMs rely on structured data, someone who understands how to make a website "readable" for a bot (using JSON-LD or Schema) would be a plus.

  • Strategic Mindset: Experience in GEO or a deep curiosity to lead in this specific space.


Preferred qualifications:

  • Agile & Curious: You have a "startup" mindset within a large organization. You aren't waiting for a manual; you are writing it
  • Data-Driven: You are comfortable with ambiguity but obsessed with data. You can find the signal in the noise of visibility scores.
  • Proactive Communicator: You can influence teams you don’t manage and present complex AI concepts to diverse audiences.
  • LLM Industry thinker: you have a natural curiosity about the evolution of LLM and stay in sync with the search industry evolution.
  • Customer experience mindset: You won’t just execute; you will provide the "human judgment" to ensure our prompts reflect customer needs. You can understand our customer design development journey and are curious about improving it asking question beyond the scope of the AI visibility team and teaming up with other members of the Digital Selling group.
  • Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes
  • Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
  • Ability to take the initiative and drive for results
  • Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery

About Us

Why TI?
  • Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics.
  • We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI
  • Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well-being is important to us.


About Texas Instruments
Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. json.title: BCBA Content Creator - Social Media & Marketing
json.descriptionHtml:
BCBA Content Creator

Above and Beyond ABA Therapy
Location: Flexible - Must be located in CO, GA, IN, NE, NC, OK, UT, VA, MD
  • ️ Part-time (10 hours per week)
This position requires active BCBA or RBT certification. Candidates who do not hold a current Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) or Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) credential will not be considered.

Above and Beyond Therapy is looking for an exceptional BCBA who is ready to use their clinical expertise in a whole new way. We invest in the delivery of outstanding quality care by designing an environment where all employees can think big and have fun - and this role is exactly that.

Our company goal is simple: you should love what you do! Above & Beyond Therapy is dedicated to the professional growth and personal happiness of all of our staff, and we constantly strive to create a supportive, collaborative, and creative workplace where everyone is excited to show up.

About the Role

We're looking for a BCBA who wants to use their clinical expertise to educate, inspire, and reach families beyond the therapy room. In this role, you'll join our Marketing team and serve as the clinical voice of ABT - creating videos, blogs, and social content that helps families understand ABA, trust our brand, and feel supported. All of it grounded in real clinical knowledge.

This is a part-time role that will grow with you. If you've ever thought "I wish more families understood what we actually do" - this is your platform.

What You'll Do ✅

  • Create engaging video, written, and social media content across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook - reels, educational posts, and stories that make ABA accessible to everyday families
  • Serve as an authentic, on-camera clinical presence and trusted face of Above & Beyond
  • Collaborate with our Marketing Coordinator and Marketing Director to develop content calendars, campaigns, and educational series
  • Visit ABT clinic locations to capture real, behind-the-scenes content (travel scope will evolve with the role)
  • Translate complex clinical concepts into relatable, digestible language for parents and caregivers
  • Monitor social media trends and adapt content to what's resonating on each platform
  • Help build a brand that connects families to the care they deserve - at scale

You Are

  • ✔️ An active BCBA in good standing with a strong clinical foundation
  • ✔️ Natural on camera - comfortable, confident, and engaging
  • ✔️ Passionate about families - you know how to speak to the parent experience and meet them where they are
  • ✔️ A creative thinker and storyteller who loves the content creation process
  • ✔️ Socially fluent - you're active on social media, understand what performs, and can ride a trend without sacrificing clinical integrity
  • ✔️ A team player who thrives in a collaborative, mission-driven environment
  • ✔️ Basic video editing skills a plus (CapCut or similar)

What We Offer

  • Competitive hourly rate: $70/hour+
    • Flexible part-time schedule at 10 hours per week that complements your existing clinical work
  • Direct collaboration with a passionate, supportive marketing team that values your clinical voice
  • Continuing education support
  • The chance to impact thousands of families
  • A mission-driven team that genuinely cares - about clients, families, and you

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

json.descriptionHtml:
We are:

Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. With strong client relationships and deep industry expertise, we help our clients operate at the speed of life through the unlimited potential of imagination, technology and intelligence. Visit us at: www.accenture.com/song

The work:

The SEO/GEO Executive Lead is the senior practitioner on the team — equally at home in a technical audit, a client strategy session, and a roadmap review with engineering. You will lead a team of SEO specialists, own the relationship with senior client stakeholders, and personally drive the quality and direction of the work.

The right person for this role has done the work at scale, knows what good looks like, and can bring others along without losing sight of execution.

Lead the work — and do it

  • Own the end-to-end SEO strategy across a large, complex web environment, from technical foundations through content and measurement

  • Personally conduct and QA audits, prioritization frameworks, and execution plans — not just delegate them

  • Step into execution mode when the work demands it, whether that means resolving a crawlability issue, structuring a migration plan, or troubleshooting indexation at the page level

  • Hold yourself and your team to deadlines, and create the conditions for others to do the same

Technical SEO ownership

  • Lead technical strategy and execution across crawlability, indexation, rendering, and site architecture

  • Drive complex workstreams including site migrations, internationalization, canonicalization strategy, and URL structure decisions

  • Build and govern systems for internal linking, structured data, pagination, and faceted navigation at scale

  • Partner directly with engineering teams — not just hand over tickets, but sit in the work, understand constraints, and find solutions together

Translate strategy into execution

  • Take business priorities, platform changes, org shifts, and emerging channel dynamics and turn them into clear, sequenced SEO roadmaps that multiple teams can act on

  • Provide practical, prioritized guidance to content, development, UX, analytics, and governance stakeholders — especially when everything feels equally urgent

  • Communicate confidently with senior client stakeholders, framing SEO decisions in terms of business impact and risk

Build for scale through tooling and automation

  • Design workflows that reduce manual SEO work using enterprise SEO platforms, crawlers, analytics tools, APIs, and custom scripting where appropriate

  • Develop templated approaches and repeatable processes that raise the floor of the team's output

  • Evaluate and implement tooling with a systems mindset — how it supports process, not just what it surfaces in a report

Manage and develop the team

  • Lead, coach, and quality-check the work of SEO specialists across the program

  • Create clarity on priorities and ownership so the team can move with confidence

  • Build a team culture where craft, accountability, and intellectual curiosity are the norm


Here’s what you’ll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in a similar SEO role including the following:
    • Technical SEO experience, including experience partnering with engineering and site architecture
    • Experience with enterprise level SEO tools to automate SEO processes (enterprise SEO platforms, crawlers, analytics, custom scripts, APIs)
    • Experience leading and executing large-scale SEO transformations (leading the work & working alongside SEO specialists where needed)
    • GEO experience and understanding how content, structure, schema, and authority affect LLM visibility
    • Ability to work in a fast paced and demanding environment as well as to balance several clients needs simultaneously

Bonus points if:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

  • Expertise on content systems and information architecture

  • Passionate about SEO, data, analytics and technology
